title: Truth-table block code
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on strings of length $n$, and let $k,p$ be natural numbers. Define the code to be the natural number obtained by interpreting as bits the list of values $f(x_r)$, indexed by $0\le r<2^k$, where $x_r$ is the string assembled from $n,k,p,r$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean-valued function on length-$n$ Boolean strings
caveat: The snippet does not define the bit-list-to-natural-number operation `ofBits`, so its bit-order convention cannot be specified from the supplied statement.
